title: Furis
extract:
The Furis is a machine pistol with a high rate of fire, causing an outcome of a high damage output, sacrificing ammo.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000; it is also a weapon crafting ingredient for  Afuris (x2).

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Innate  polarity.
Can use the Furis-exclusive  Winds of Purity mod.

Acquisition
The Furis's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Earth to Venus Junction.

Notes

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Furis Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Furis with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Furis Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Yao Shrubs, and 80  Lamentus.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 20 weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Furis's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 14 rounds to a maximum of 280. Once all ammunition is expended, the Furis reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as  Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
Using  Pistol Ammo Mutation can help regain lost ammo when needed to compensate for the Furis' low ammo efficiency. Alternatively, use the  Pistol Scavenger Aura or bring along Squad Ammo Restores.

Trivia

"Furis" means "thief" in Latin.
A Lotus symbol seems to appear at the end of the magazine, justifying itself as a Tenno weapon.
The Market blueprint icon of the Furis once did not have the appearance of the actual model, instead it lacked a magazine, its stock appeared to slender inwards (without having a "butt" on the end) and its barrel had edges below (making a spike of some kind). This has since been fixed.
